package.description: A free DVD/CD disc image creating software.

en-US.description: A free DVD/CD disc image creating software.
en-US.longDescription: DVD to ISO is a free DVD/CD image creating tool, it can help you to rip and convert DVD/CD data into a single ISO image file. It is very easy to use, no complicated settings, just a few mouse clicks, you can easily create your own disc images for optical discs by yourself.
